pages.text: $(l)Lumen Glade$(/l) — gentle blue-green meadows.$(br)$(l)Glowroot Forest$(/l) — dense, dim woods of giant self-lit trees.$(br)$(l)Glasspetal Crags$(/l) — blue-violet crystal highlands.$(br)$(l)Sporefall Jungle$(/l) — lush rainforest of giant glowing mushrooms.

$(l)Moonmire$(/l) — a glowing swamp of Lumenwater pools.$(br)$(l)Undercrown Caverns$(/l) — the deep cave biome, lit by dense crystal ore and hanging glowvine.$(br)$(l)Stillbloom Basin$(/l) — a rare, bright sanctuary of giant Stillbloom flowers.
